+    pending = [(value, result, 0, False)]
+
+    while pending:
+        item, parent, index, finish = pending.pop()
+        if finish:
+            original, children = item
+            if isinstance(original, Mapping):
+                copied = type(original)((key, child[0]) for key, child in children)

+                copied = type(original)(child[0] for child in children)

+class TestSanitization(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_values_preserve_keys_and_scalars(self):
+        data = {'password': 'my-secret', 'secret-key': [True, 123, None, 'secret']}
+        self.assertEqual(remove_values(data, [b'secret']),
+                         {'password': 'my-********', 'secret-key': [True, 123, None, '********']})
+        self.assertEqual(remove_values(123, ['123']), 123)
+
+    def test_keys_and_ignore(self):
+        data = {'password': 1, 'my-password': {'password': 2},
+                'changed': {'password': 3}, '_ansible_password': 4,
+                'items': [{'password': 5}]}
+        self.assertEqual(sanitize_keys(data, [b'password', 'changed'], frozenset(('changed',))),
+                         {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 1,
+                          'my-********': {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 2},
+                          'changed': {'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 3},
+                          '_ansible_password': 4,
+                          'items': [{'VALUE_SPECIFIED_IN_NO_LOG_PARAMETER': 5}]})
+        self.assertEqual(sanitize_keys(['password'], ['password']), ['password'])
+
+    def test_deep_containers(self):
